description: The 2021 Ford Edge SE proves that an entry trim does not have to feel stripped down. Finished in Silver Metallic, this front-wheel-drive two-row SUV combines Fords 2.0-liter EcoBoost power, a spacious cabin, a large SYNC 4A touchscreen, and a broad suite of standard driver-assistance technology in a package that is easy to maneuver around Wesley Chapel and comfortable enough for longer Tampa Bay travel.  Power comes from the twin-scroll 2.0-liter EcoBoost four-cylinder paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission. Turbocharging gives the Edge useful response for merging and passing, while front-wheel drive keeps the layout straightforward for drivers whose travel is primarily on pavement. Four-wheel independent suspension and electric power-assisted steering help the Edge feel composed in traffic and stable at highway speed, giving it the kind of easygoing road manners that make a midsize crossover work well as a daily vehicle.  Inside, the Edge uses its footprint efficiently. The two-row cabin gives front and rear passengers generous room without asking the driver to manage the bulk of a three-row SUV. The rear seat folds when cargo space takes priority, opening a broad area for luggage, shopping, sports equipment, home-improvement supplies, or weekend gear. Concealed cargo storage adds another useful place for smaller items, while the wide rear opening makes loading straightforward.  Technology is a major strength of the 2021 Edge SE. SYNC 4A centers the cabin around a large 12-inch touchscreen with enhanced voice recognition, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, cloud-connected functions, and access to vehicle settings and entertainment. FordPass Connect supports remote functions and vehicle-status features through a compatible connected account, while push-button start and intelligent access help simplify the daily routine. Dual-zone automatic climate control gives the driver and front passenger separate comfort settings.  Ford Co-Pilot360 brings a strong group of driver-assistance features as standard equipment. Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert helps when changing lanes or backing from a parking space. Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking can provide additional support when a potential frontal collision is detected, while lane-keeping technology helps the driver remain aware of unintended lane movement. Automatic high beams, rear parking sensors, a rearview camera with washer, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, and a comprehensive airbag system add further confidence.  The Edge SE also looks more finished than the word base might suggest. LED lighting, aluminum wheels, body-color exterior elements, privacy glass, and a clean roofline give the SUV a modern appearance that works just as well in an office parking lot as it does on a family weekend.  This Edge is Ford Gold Certified, adding a 172-point inspection, a 12-month/12,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, a 7-year/100,000-mile Powertrain Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance, and applicable FordPass Rewards Points.
